stack.search: Local search in the legacy site (MiniSearch, provider: local)
stack.math: MathJax 3 injected from cdn.jsdelivr.net in legacy-config/theme/index.ts enhanceApp()

architecture.pattern: Static site generation (SSG) with file-based routing; srcDir src/, cleanUrls: false (pages published as .html)
architecture.i18n: Legacy site locales: root = pt (lang pt-BR), /en/ (en-US), /es/ (es-ES); trees mirrored under src/, src/en/, src/es/
architecture.navigation: Hand-written sidebars per locale for /docs/ and /dgs-components/ in legacy-config/pt.ts, en.ts, es.ts (893 lines total); navbar item 'Radar de tecnologia' and GitHub social link
architecture.hosting: Amazon S3 website hosting, bucket engineerguide.db1.com.br, region us-east-1, no CloudFront

structure.legacy-config/config.mts: Site config: title, favicon, logo, locales, local search, cleanUrls false, metaChunk
structure.legacy-config/pt.ts|en.ts|es.ts: Per-locale lang, outline label, nav and sidebars
structure.legacy-config/theme/style.css: 142-line theme override (--vp-* vars, hero gradients, custom containers, .DocSearch residue)
structure.legacy-config/theme/index.ts: Extends DefaultTheme and injects MathJax script
structure.src/index.md: Home (layout: home, hero + 3 features); mirrored in src/en/index.md and src/es/index.md
structure.src/docs/: Guide content: engineering/, qa/, devops/ (pt); en/es have engineering/ and qa/ plus engineering/best-practices/devops/
structure.src/dgs-components/: Accelerators: golden-path/, easy-monitor/, easy-docs/, easy-connect/ (+ easy-monitor-en/ duplicate in pt tree)
structure.src/public/: Static assets: img/ (favicon, logo, docs, components), assets/ebooks/GEP_2021_EBOOK_ARQUITETURA.pdf
structure..github/workflows/prod-deploy-app.yaml: Push to main: yarn install --immutable, yarn build, OIDC (vars.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN), aws s3 sync the legacy build output with --delete; CloudFront invalidation commented out
